samuel1.24.p1.b1.text: So Saul took three thousand chosen men from all Israel and went to look for David and his men in the region of the Rocks of the Wild Goats.

samuel1.24.p1.b2.text: David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.

samuel1.24.p2.b1.text: Soon Saul came to the sheepfolds along the road, where there was a cave…And David and his men were hiding in the recesses of the cave.

samuel1.24.p2.b2.text: This is the day about which the LORD said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, that you may do with him as you wish.’

samuel1.24.p2.b3.text: Then David crept up secretly and cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.

samuel1.24.p3.b1.text: Afterward, David’s conscience was stricken because he had cut off the corner of Saul’s robe.

samuel1.24.p3.b2.text: The LORD forbid that I should do such a thing to my master, the LORD’s anointed…

samuel1.24.p3.b3.text: Then Saul left the cave and went on his way.

samuel1.24.p4.b2.text: Why do you listen to the words of men who say, ‘Look, David intends to harm you’?

samuel1.24.p4.b3.text: Behold, this day you have seen with your own eyes that the LORD delivered you into my hand in the cave…but I spared you…

samuel1.24.p5.b1.text: See, my father, look at the corner of your robe in my hand.

samuel1.24.p5.b2.text: May the LORD judge between you and me, and may the LORD take vengeance on you, but my hand will never be against you.

samuel1.24.p5.b3.text: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?

samuel1.24.p6.b1.text: Is that your voice, David my son?

samuel1.24.p6.b3.text: You are more righteous than I, for you have rewarded me with good, though I have rewarded you with evil.

samuel1.24.p6.b4.text: May the LORD reward you with good for what you have done for me this day.

samuel1.24.p7.b1.text: Now I know for sure that you will be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands.

samuel1.24.p7.b2.text: So now, swear to me by the LORD that you will not cut off my descendants…

samuel1.24.p7.b3.text: So David gave his oath to Saul…

samuel1.24.p7.b4.text: Then Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
